description: In this emergency podcast, Matt talks with Christy and Monica about the election changes in Louisiana after the Louisiana v. Callais Supreme Court decision. In this episode: What the Supreme Court ruling actually did to the Voting Rights Act Why Louisiana’s congressional maps were struck down
